summary: The existing package-backed browser runner adds a controlled blur-to-explicit-recovery witness for local SvgSessionHost and presentation-only SvgExternalSessionHost. Six local cycles use unmodified native RAF timestamps: suspension retires the generation and frame, a foreground suspended dwell exceeds the existing 1000ms policy threshold, the first resumed frame establishes a fresh boundary without advance, and the second advances only its observed native frame interval. Old-generation completion while a fresh request is pending must preserve the accepted SVG and that request; a genuine fresh completion must change the retained scene while unrelated root/layer/beta descendants remain identical. Six external cycles retain the same epoch/baseline, invalidate the old acquisition, explicitly demand its replacement, reject exact old tokens without consuming the replacement, and then apply its fresh completion. External recovery introduces no authority clock or Resume API. Independent ownership observation follows actual owned RAF callback re-registration and matches listener registrations by target/type/function/capture. Disposal is inspected synchronously before an uncancelled one-shot frame could execute and disappear, then checked again after native-frame drainage and late calls. Seven actual-browser controls omit resume, deliberately misroute old replies through current tokens, corrupt the first resumed callback timestamp, or suppress listener/frame cleanup; only the named oracle failure counts. Injected negative timestamps are recorded separately from normal native timestamps. The ordinary external fixture mount owns both the host and input bridge: this source observed two reported host listeners and thirteen actual registrations including eleven input listeners. Fresh externalMountControl alone omits that input host while externalDispose expects it, so the witness uses the existing ordinary mount; the original Option.None preflight failures remain fixture integration failures rather than a producer defect. Local Chromium preflight passed the joined journeys and controls. This record captures the source/software boundary, not completed hosted three-browser acceptance, genuine OS/tab backgrounding, transport/native/product recovery, heap/GPU memory, performance, publication or adoption. Rendering1479 remains separately accepted; parent4645 retains its entire remaining programme promise.
title: Explicit SVG recovery needs a composed frame, stale-reply and ownership witness
